name: Bismuth selenide
summary: Topological insulator and the cleanest evidence for the nonequilibrium extension: under mid-infrared drive, Floquet-Bloch states appear, that is, bands that do not exist in equilibrium. No order parameter is switched; instead the band structure itself is re-formed by the light field.

degrees_of_freedom.description: Gap opened at the Dirac point, only under drive
Selenium vacancies dope the bulk undesirably n-type

inputs.notes: Photon energy 0.12 eV at 10 micrometers (Wang 2013); control measurements at 7.5 and 8 micrometers

couplings.source: Wang, Steinberg, Jarillo-Herrero & Gedik, Science 342, 453 (2013), doi:10.1126/science.1239834
couplings.notes: Floquet dressing has no physical threshold - the state exists as soon as the drive is running. The threshold of 1e-06 is purely a case distinction between drive on and drive off. In v0.1 this was incorrectly given as 0.5 mJ/cm^2, as if it were a real threshold.

validity.condition: 2*kappa = sqrt(4V^2+(hbar*omega)^2) - hbar*omega, approximately 2V^2/(hbar*omega), hence proportional to E^2 and thus to the fluence; calibrated to 53 meV at 0.4 mJ/cm^2

couplings.source: Wang, Steinberg, Jarillo-Herrero & Gedik, Science 342, 453 (2013), doi:10.1126/science.1239834, Eq. S1/S2, doi:10.1126/science.1239834
couplings.notes: Exponent corrected from 0.5 to 1.0 relative to v0.1. The exponent 0.5 applies to the dynamical gap 2*Delta = 62 meV at the avoided crossing, not to the Dirac gap.

couplings.source: Directly measured quantity in time-resolved ARPES
Device-dependent; in thick crystals the bulk can hardly be gated throughout
Bulk conduction short-circuits the surface channel; the central practical problem of this material

states.label: Floquet-Bloch state with opened Dirac gap

driven_states.emergent_property: Floquet-Bloch sidebands. The Dirac gap of 53 +/- 4 meV at the Dirac point occurs ONLY under circular polarization (broken time reversal); the dynamical gap of 62 +/- 5 meV at the avoided crossing n = 0 / n = +/-1 occurs under LINEAR polarization. The two gaps belong to different polarizations and are not interchangeable.
driven_states.source: Wang, Steinberg, Jarillo-Herrero & Gedik, Science 342, 453 (2013), doi:10.1126/science.1239834
driven_states.notes: Downgraded from established to single_group. The phenomenon is independently established - WSe2 (Aeschlimann et al. 2021, with an s-polarized test against Volkov contributions), topological insulator surfaces (Ito et al. 2023), graphene (two independent groups 2025), MnBi2Te4 (2024). On Bi2Se3 itself, however, all measurements come from the Gedik group (Wang 2013; Mahmood 2016). The entry describes a material, not the phenomenon - hence single_group. Polarization assignment made more precise after checking the sources: circular for 2*kappa, linear for 2*Delta.
driven_states.measured_quantity: angle-resolved photoemission, Dirac gap and dynamical gap

driven_states.emergent_property: Volkov-free Floquet-Bloch state: sidebands n = 0 and +/-1, hybridization gap at the avoided crossing of 68 meV at 11.5 mW pump power (Floquet parameter 0.42). The gap opens only perpendicular to the field direction.
driven_states.source: Mahmood et al., Nature Physics 12, 306 (2016), doi:10.1038/nphys3609
driven_states.notes: The methodological reference work on separating out Volkov contributions. Under s-polarized excitation the field lies purely in the plane, the first-order Volkov contribution vanishes exactly; what remains is Floquet. In addition, the avoided crossings are independent of Volkov effects, because Volkov states do not renormalize the band structure of the solid. Limitation: one group, one setup; 68 meV is close to the energy resolution; the temperature is not stated in the main text or the methods.

gaps: Lifetime equals the pulse duration (250 fs). A continuous-wave drive would heat the material; separating drive from heating is unresolved.
Bulk conduction through selenium vacancies masks the surface channel in transport. The interesting physics is accessible spectroscopically, but hardly electrically.
For Bi2Se3 itself there is no independent reproduction. All measurements come from the same group. The phenomenon is independently confirmed in other materials.
The edge c_gate_bulk is device-dependent and practically ineffective in thick crystals.
